entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider offering multi-level state management for users, sessions, and agents. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining semantic, keyword, and entity matching with time-aware capabilities to track current and past events.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for high-efficiency recall. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance with built-in connectors for Notion, GitHub, Google Drive, and other productivity tools.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official context database that uses a filesystem paradigm and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to significantly reduce token costs. It provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging and has demonstrated substantial gains in task completion on the LoCoMo10 benchmark.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agent that synthesizes cited answers across complex ideas and entities. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph that extracts typed relationships without LLM calls and runs automated background cycles for memory consolidation.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent growth. It acts as an LLM wrapper that automates storage and retrieval across providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A stateful agent library that asynchronously extracts reasoning-based conclusions from conversations and events. It tracks evolving entities such as users and ideas, providing prompt-ready context via Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, enabling version control through branching and merging of markdown context trees. It delivers high-speed, sub-100ms access via a 5-tier retrieval system.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, SQLite-backed memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance. It integrates with MCP for agentic tool support and features temporal knowledge graphs and episodic compression.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that refines agent performance through evaluation and lesson retention. It generates filesystem-first traces and playbooks to distill successful behaviors into local models via training plans.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin using a SQLite-backed DAG to maintain hierarchical summaries without losing raw message lineage. It includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand for precise recall within bounded active prompts.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers and OpenAI-compatible providers, including an automated Docker and PostgreSQL setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems utilizing an open, human-readable YAML engram format. It supports hierarchical scoping for team-specific knowledge and integrates with MCP tools like Claude Code.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other MCP clients. It uses SQLite for custody and includes tools to manually edit, delete, or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that eliminates cloud dependencies and API keys for total local privacy. It employs hybrid retrieval using BM25, vector search, and graph traversal via MCP server and Hermes plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases cache hits by 4–12× through prefix reordering and deduplication. It reduces input tokens by approximately 36% for long-context workloads in SGLang, vLLM, and Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable retrieval using why_retrieved tags and contradiction tracking. It ensures memory hygiene through automated stale scans and maintains a native outcome ledger for agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide bounded evidence packing.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses a local-first architecture with SQLite-vec and GGUF models, operating as an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that indexes files, URLs, and codebases using automated tagging and summarization. It utilizes edge tags for navigable relationships and tracks agent intentions through reflective skill instructions.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It prioritizes high-priority memories during prefetch and supports GLiNER2 for entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of memories without residual summaries. It provides transparency through a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider featuring semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports automatic memory mirroring from native Hermes tools and utilizes session snapshots with TTL support.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and searching, with support for query expansion and result reranking.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A comprehensive suite of 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It combines BM25, vector, and graph search methods with automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that enables Hermes Agent to generate prototypes, motion graphics, and decks. It integrates with over 150 design systems and 22 local CLIs to bridge the gap between design and code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It provides agents with specialized knowledge for security auditing and financial fraud detection.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows Hermes Agent to generate editable .drawio diagrams from natural language prompts. It is particularly useful for visualizing codebase structures across Python, JS, Go, and Rust using a vast library of cloud and AI logos.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables skills to evolve collectively through automatic deduplication and quality improvements. It creates a shared evolution loop to synchronize skill libraries across different agents and team members.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: A content auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass rewrite process. It utilizes a tiered replacement table and 49 pattern categories to remove structural and rhythmic AI fingerprints.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library providing thematic skill collections for architecture, UX, and product strategy. These frameworks are based on established industry guidelines and are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It streamlines development by generating both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, utilizing progressive disclosure to reduce token consumption. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of tools for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without relying on yt-dlp. It enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and browse channels and playlists.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills with ARD v0.9 compliance and urn:air identifiers. It ensures trusted transactions through Ed25519-signed bids and dual settlement rails via Stripe and MPP.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts through the dynamic generation of custom 'analytical lenses.' It includes validated prisms for simulation and optimization, along with a reflection tool to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A specialized workflow that transforms rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a formal spec review gate for quality evaluation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents that uses a durable card model for tracking tasks and decisions. It features local-first storage for easy diff reviews and mandatory QA gates to verify work before completion.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Implements literate programming by weaving source code and documentation into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits between the source and the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A self-memory system that captures high-value decisions in markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories and documentation into agentskills.io-compliant skills using AST analysis. It ensures accuracy by linking every instruction directly to specific source code line numbers.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official skill set for FLUX image generation, providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and precise hex color specifications.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills featuring an OpenAPI-driven CLI for lifecycle management. It supports recursive dependency resolution and integrated monetization via TON and Stripe.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage for large toolsets. It maintains persistent connections to multiple MCP servers via a socket-based daemon.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud to manage files, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses secure HTTPS communication and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It leverages Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading and supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts for various surfaces, including Discord and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles to find bugs. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning without modifying the code.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by focusing on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to safely modify code and detect concurrency anti-patterns.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, embeddings, and RRF fusion to find the most relevant skills. It integrates via a pre_llm_call hook and degrades gracefully if optional dependencies are missing.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC and various payment protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, featuring daily automatic updates for all included tools. Users can easily execute agents via nix run commands to support workflows involving Claude Code or GitHub Copilot.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers specialized scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs like Hermes on Android via Termux. It utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI to<pad><pad><pad> provide hardware and UI access on ARM64 mobile devices.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop solution that requires no admin rights or Docker to operate. This portable setup includes a GUI, local model support, and a dynamic tool maker for creating custom API and Python handlers.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Features a one-line installation script designed for rapid deployment of Hermes Agent within a Termux environment. It supports over 200 models, including OpenAI and local Ollama instances, to prioritize privacy and low latency on mobile hardware.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with cloud-native guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using kernel-level enforcement for network, filesystem, and process limits. It allows for dynamic security policies ranging from strict to permissive while integrating with IDEs and MCP servers.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom builds using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package designed for reproducible deployments through declarative management of configurations and systemd services. It ensures secure secrets handling via sops-nix and supports both Nix-managed and interactive CLI installs.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready deployment for Ubuntu and Debian that configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. This headless setup is optimized for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It enables task scheduling, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack specifically built for deployment via Portainer. It features an integrated ttyd web terminal and utilizes GitHub Actions for automated image builds.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables the dispatch and monitoring of multi-agent workflows without external dependencies. It distinguishes itself through real-time WebSocket telemetry and built-in security features like secret detection and trust scoring for every task.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Providing both TUI and web dashboards, this control surface manages Hermes alongside other coding agents across parallel git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces. It prioritizes security by sandboxing agent environments using Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes from a single VPS agent into automated specialist teams. It comes pre-equipped with specific skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management to streamline infrastructure tasks.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent through a level-based architecture, this framework facilitates seamless task delegation and handoffs between orchestrators and specialists. It focuses on operational reliability with bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and automated backups.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, featuring durable memory and scheduled execution. It stands out by providing visual org charts to help users map and manage complex agent team hierarchies.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: Acting as a mission control center, this project uses a Kanban-style interface to supervise autonomous Hermes agents from a single screen. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by live-streaming agent reasoning and requiring manual approval for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents through a master orchestrator to handle research, planning, and implementation. It enforces a rigorous development lifecycle with mandatory reviewer and tester gates for all security and code refactoring tasks.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage the lifecycle of Leader and Specialist agents. It features a real-time Web UI that combines agent dialogue monitoring with a Kanban flow for local tool and task management.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Focused on meta-optimization, this project uses an automated outer-loop search to evolve and improve agent harness code. It orchestrates benchmark evaluations via Hermes to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This unique arena orchestrates two competing AI companies, each powered by nine autonomous agents, in a race for GitHub stars. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time scoreboard to visualize metrics and agent-to-agent competition.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It is designed to prevent context pollution in parent agents while enforcing safety through configurable timeouts and output limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that maps symbols and dependencies to reduce token usage and tool calls. It accelerates agent responses by auto-syncing the index in real-time as files are modified.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A high-performance Rust-based TUI and dashboard for tracking token usage and costs. It provides a centralized way to monitor spending across multiple platforms, including Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic, system prompts, and tool schemas. It allows developers to debug Hermes Agent and other coding agents using structured diffs to compare adjacent requests.
entries.bergside/typeui: A UI generation framework that provides design systems and layout guidance for AI. It integrates via MCP servers and plugins to help any AI provider build better interfaces.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that orchestrates autonomous CTO loops for issue triage and PR management. It adds 23 specialized skills and enables project control via Telegram, Slack, and Discord.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-made CLI skins and themes for the Hermes terminal UI. It uses YAML-based inheritance to allow users to customize visual aesthetics and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents featuring encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It enables agent identity registration with @handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for vLLM and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It provides real-time visual supervision of AI actions and uses de-structured bookmarks for agent context.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents. It allows for per-folder configuration, enabling seamless switching between project-local memories, tools, and instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup using RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes 40+ specialized skills for finance and DevOps with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation suite that deploys a Hermes Agent stack and 12+ supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter for agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It uses seven structural detectors to identify failure modes without requiring LLM calls.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps complex model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles credential transfers.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager provides a unified desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other major AI coding CLIs like Claude Code and Codex. Built with Tauri 2, it offers a lightweight solution for users who need to switch between multiple agent environments on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that provides a unified GUI for Hermes Agent and other CLI-based agents, featuring built-in tools for web searching and file writing. It distinguishes itself by automating the creation of editable office documents, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface offers full feature parity with the Hermes CLI through a functional three-panel layout that includes a workspace file browser. It helps users manage context effectively by integrating a dedicated 'context ring' for real-time token usage monitoring.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Designed as a comprehensive desktop companion, this app simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent through guided installation and configuration. It provides an integrated GUI for managing sessions and toolsets across various local and remote AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: This dashboard focuses on multi-platform connectivity, allowing users to configure Hermes Agent for use across Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It supports isolated profiles for managing distinct models, skills, and file storage within a single web interface.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task orchestration. It includes a full file browser powered by Monaco, a PTY terminal, and an integrated browser for managing memories and MCP catalogs.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct shell access via an embedded terminal and supports both local and SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It organizes agent activity through native views for Kanban boards, skills management, and cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted dashboard acts as a control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a ZOO Swarm Monitor to track agent health and Kanban pipelines. It provides real-time tool call visualization and a dedicated interface for managing the lifecycle of MCP servers.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: Built with Tauri and Rust, this Windows-optimized desktop application provides a localized experience for managing local and cloud model providers. It features an advanced UI specifically designed for monitoring tasks, memory, and agent skills.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This macOS-native session browser focuses on analytics and history, offering a 'Quota Meter' to track usage limits across various coding agents. It ensures privacy by using local-only indexing for searching conversation histories without telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This macOS workspace is tailored for Orgo cloud computers, offering one-click automated installation of Hermes Agent on fresh cloud VMs. It uniquely supports a WebRTC voice mode, enabling verbal interaction with the agent via OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges the gap between the web and the agent by feeding active browser context directly into Hermes prompts. It connects to both local and remote API gateways, allowing the agent to 'see' the user's current web environment.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this terminal-based dashboard provides a keyboard-centric way to manage Hermes profiles, skills, and memory. It includes specialized rendering for LaTeX and markdown, alongside Kanban boards for diagnosing agentic workflows.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA functions as a Telegram Mini App, providing a terminal-style chat interface for Hermes on the go. It allows users to spawn background agents and monitor system health or cron jobs directly from their mobile device.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This zero-install Windows solution requires no admin rights or Docker, making Hermes Agent fully portable. It comes pre-loaded with 100 tools, including local TTS and ComfyUI extensions, and features a workflow engine for multi-step automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Featuring a modern glassmorphic design, this web interface provides real-time log streaming and task tracking for self-hosted Hermes instances. It serves as a centralized hub for managing MCP servers, cron jobs, and agent skills through a browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard emphasizes process monitoring by providing a real-time activity feed that tracks costs and model distribution. It utilizes FTS5 for deep, searchable conversation history and offers read-only inspection of agent configuration and skills.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan-ui is a chat-first workspace that uses SSE streaming and tool approval cards to give users granular control over agent actions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for separate API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It includes a visual 'Skill Store' for one-click installations of over 50 curated capabilities.
